trajectory.claim: TrendForce forecast 2024 QLC enterprise SSD bit shipments at 30 EB, about four times 2023 volume.
TrendForce estimated 2024 AI-related SSD procurement capacity above 45 EB.
TrendForce reported 3Q24 total enterprise SSD procurement volume up 15% QoQ and industry revenue up 28.6% QoQ.
TrendForce reported 4Q24 enterprise SSD revenue for major suppliers at US$7.34B, down 0.5% QoQ.
trajectory.no_lookahead_guard: This March 2025 measurement cannot appear in a 2024 point-in-time replay.

comparability_findings: The April 30 EB forecast and August greater-than-45 EB estimate are not revisions of the same predicate: QLC enterprise SSD bits and AI-related SSD procurement capacity have different product/workload scopes.
The 3Q24 15% procurement-volume growth is a realized quarterly direction/magnitude observation but does not reveal the absolute EB or unit denominator.
The 4Q24 US$7.34B major-supplier revenue observation is a later-known revenue Outcome surface, not an exabyte or unit Outcome.
No recovered public methodological-primary source in this bounded pass supplies a directly comparable realized full-year 2024 enterprise SSD or QLC enterprise SSD EB total.

lead_dispositions.researcher_interpretation: The 2024 enterprise SSD demand acceleration is now supported not only by vendor self-statements but by a methodological-primary market trajectory: full-year capacity expectations during 2024, then realized 3Q procurement growth and later 4Q revenue measurement.
lead_dispositions.canonical_boundary: Do not convert forecast EB, quarterly procurement growth and quarterly revenue into one synthetic demand series.

lead_dispositions.researcher_interpretation: A methodological-primary April 2024 forecast places QLC enterprise SSD bit shipments at 30 EB for the year, complementing Solidigm's vendor-specific greater-than-100EB cumulative QLC history. The two measures are neither the same period nor the same market scope.
lead_dispositions.canonical_boundary: The 30 EB number remains a Judgment vintage until a comparable realized annual QLC enterprise SSD measurement is recovered.

source_types_examined: TrendForce public press-center methodological-primary market releases
public search for other methodological-primary enterprise-SSD absolute-volume series
search_depth.not_found_semantics: Failure to recover a public realized full-year 2024 EB/unit total does not prove that no such measured series exists, including inside paid market datasets.

next_actions: Ground the four TrendForce captures as one market-trajectory Evidence packet with forecast/estimate versus later market-observation roles kept separate.
Project the April and August full-year quantities only as contemporaneous Judgment/Expectation, never Reality.
Project the 3Q procurement/revenue growth and later-known 4Q major-supplier revenue only if predicate/scope/period semantics are explicit and no-lookahead is preserved.
Keep realized full-year 2024 enterprise SSD/QLC EB or unit Outcome unresolved pending a directly comparable methodological-primary measurement.
